Name: Cheran
Summary: Cheran was a son of Dishon, the son of Anah, and a descendant of Seir the Horite.
KeyStory: Cheran is named last among Dishon's four children.
RelatedPeople: Dishon, Son of Anah; Hemdan; Eshban; Ithran
LifeLesson: God's story keeps moving through families we know almost nothing about — and He knows them all.
